summary: Added 29 adversarial tests across 7 describe blocks (lifecycle edge cases, idempotency abuse, approval/hash tampering, authorization boundaries, student visibility, input validation, Review A orphan repro) to apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/convex/teacher/content-authoring-drafts.test.ts. The new tests exercised the real Phase 1 modules, the real computeComponentContentHash, the real resolveComponentKind, and the real Convex handlers against a mock ctx.db boundary. Two new tests in the Review A orphan block exposed a real bug — editRejectedDraftHandler was not refreshing lessons.metadata.authoringActivityIds after the edit, so a subsequent idempotent saveTeacherDraft call could orphan non-primary activities from a multi-activity section. Applied a minimal fix (one ctx.db.patch mirroring saveTeacherDraftHandler's post-insert patch) and kept both new tests as regression coverage. All 29 new tests pass; the targeted Phase 2 gate is 4 files / 68 tests / exit 0; npx tsc --noEmit, npm run ws:im3:lint, and CI=true npm run test all exit 0. The aggregate 'vitest run apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/lib/teacher/content-authoring apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/convex' command exits 1, but the failure set is the same 12 pre-existing test failures already documented in phase-2-acceptance-result.json (roster-import-wrappers 7, schema-vany-audit 1, seed/practice-blueprint 3, seed/seed-demo-e2e 1) — none in content-authoring-drafts.test.ts or any file the Phase 2 changes could affect. No _add_types.* or measure/monorepo-ops.md files were staged.
nonblocking_findings: The orphan-cleanup regression test exercises the case where edit-after-reject is followed by an idempotent saveTeacherDraft with the same idempotencyKey. The idempotencyKey is currently treated as a write-time field that editRejectedDraftHandler can change. If a future caller passes a DIFFERENT idempotencyKey at edit-after-reject, the original key can no longer find the lesson and the orphan list patch would be skipped. This is a design choice, not a correctness bug, and is documented by the existing same-key test in the adversarial block. File: apps/integrated-math-3/convex/teacher/content-authoring.ts

loadAuthoredLesson selects the latest version via versions[versions.length - 1] rather than an explicit sort by version/createdAt (carried over from Review A); it relies on Convex insertion ordering. Not introduced or worsened by the Phase 2 change. File: apps/integrated-math-3/convex/teacher/content-authoring.ts
evidence: 29 new adversarial it() blocks across 7 describe blocks: Phase 2 — Adversarial — Lifecycle edge cases (6), Idempotency abuse (3), Approval/hash tampering (4), Authorization boundaries (6), Student visibility failure paths (3), Input validation (5), Review A orphan activity repro (2).

All 29 new tests execute the real Convex handlers (saveTeacherDraftHandler, submitDraftForReviewHandler, reviewAuthoredLessonHandler, editRejectedDraftHandler, publishAuthoredLessonHandler, assignAuthoredLessonHandler, getAuthoredLessonForStudentHandler) imported at runtime from the production module — no handler re-implementation, no shadow module, no broad mock of Phase 1 normalize/validate/sanitize or of computeComponentContentHash / resolveComponentKind.

Mock ctx.db boundary only: store arrays and IDs are observable to the test (asserted via array lengths and individual row lookups), so the tests are live-behavior tests, not source-guard tests. Phase 1 utilities remain unmocked per anti-patterns guidance.

Review A nonblocking finding reproduced: prior to the fix, edit-after-reject left metadata.authoringActivityIds stale (deleteLessonTree reset it to []), and a subsequent saveTeacherDraft with a different activity count could not clean non-primary activities from the new lesson_version's phase_sections walk. The new test 'after edit-after-reject followed by an idempotent re-save, no orphan activity rows remain' failed before the fix (3 activities remained instead of 1) and passes after the fix.

Minimal fix: one ctx.db.patch at the end of editRejectedDraftHandler mirroring saveTeacherDraftHandler's post-insert metadata refresh (authoringActivityIds set to the freshly inserted activityIds). Other code paths, signatures, and behavior unchanged. The fix is consistent with the existing reviewer comments and the saveTeacherDraftHandler pattern at the same module.

A3 compliance: count assertions use Vitest's .toHaveLength(n) or .length array access (e.g. toHaveLength(3), toHaveLength(2), toHaveLength(1)) — no rg -q '[0-9]+' digit-only substrings in any new test.

A4 compliance: every adversarial block has at least one positive assertion (handler returns success / record exists) and at least one negative assertion (rejects.toThrow, expect(...).toBeNull(), expect(...).toHaveLength(0)). No vacuous zero-completion 'markers consistent' checks.

A5 compliance: the audit JSON reports the real exit code for every cited command — the aggregate vitest command is documented as exit 1 with the explicit pre-existing failure set attributed, not as 'all checks pass'.

Junk-file discipline: _add_types.py, _add_types.ts, and measure/monorepo-ops.md are unchanged in the working tree and absent from the commit. git show --name-only HEAD lists only the two track/app files.
